Purpose of Submittal: The purpose of this action item is to seek Board of Trustees approval, under the policy on Approval and Execution of Contracts and Other Binding Documents, of a change order to the Dining Services contract with Performance Food Group, Inc.
This contract is for a Prime Food Vendor to supply groceries and sundries to URI Dining Services as needed.
The original award predated the policy on Approval and Execution of Contracts and Other Binding Documents , but Board approval was obtained in June 2024 via a change order .
We are seeking to extend the contract for another year and are seeking an increase in the contract value of an additional $6.6M based on forecasted spend for FY25, which is in line with the annual expenditure.

Points to Consider: The Performance Food Group, Inc. contract was previously approved in September 2023 and June 2024 for increases that brought the contract total to $27.4.
The current proposed increase of roughly $6.6M to extend the contract for another year is in line with the annual usage and prior spend of this contract.
This contract represents ongoing support services that are part of the current operations of the campus.
